answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable bond that peers can slash when duplicate or fake identities are proven. At the dawn of each epoch, agents publish a saffron-signed attestation tying their past work to a single public key, so a plume of fresh accounts cannot borrow reputation for free. Running many identities then costs a separate bond per identity, while honest agents keep and recover theirs, making mass fakery expensive and easy to spot.
